name: FuzzyNamespace CRDT semantics
summary: Adopt CRDT semantics (LWW-Register or stronger) for FuzzyNamespace using a new Forma.updated: UUID64 property and UUID64.after() as a Lamport/HLC clock, to structurally eliminate duplicate namespace entries for the same id. Follows from ZudaO investigation: World.insertOne's new persist-before-register ordering can double-register an id in FuzzyNamespace since addForma has no per-id invariant.
